purpose: Repair two independently identified schema/semantic defects that prevent the immutable c158 formal retail source from being consumed, without changing its bytes, window, feature thresholds, or any unrelated mechanism rule.

defect_1_trajectory_binding.repair_rule: Accept exactly the existing required field set with optional freeze_update; reject every other extra or missing field; when freeze_update is present require an integer equal to start_update and the first loaded frame update.

defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.current_incorrect_rule: The trigger ball must equal decoded_curve_end in both the initial and before frames.
defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.replacement_rule: The trigger ball must be the final active-chain entity in both frames, have suck_count zero, advance by exactly expected_pretrigger_advance from the initial frame to the before frame, equal decoded_curve_end in the before frame, and be absent at trigger.
defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.unchanged_survivor_rule: Every surviving ball must still advance by exactly expected_pretrigger_advance and enter suck_count 1 with unchanged update_count.
defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.unchanged_recurrence_rule: All subsequent removals and distances must still satisfy speed equals previous_suck_count shifted right by two, counter increments by one, exact topology, locked score/shooter/pending state, and complete removal coverage.
defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.diagnostic_isolation_result: Changing only a non-evidence diagnostic copy of update 11341 terminal distance from 3756.875 to the obsolete 3757.0 assumption makes the remaining 179-frame oracle pass, isolating this single rule.
defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.semantic_correction: Require the same pretrigger advance for the terminal ball that the oracle already requires for every survivor.

permitted_code_changes: Update _trajectory_from_probe field validation exactly as defect_1_trajectory_binding.repair_rule specifies.
Update verify_loss_sequence_frames trigger-ball pretrigger distance validation exactly as defect_2_terminal_pretrigger_motion.replacement_rule specifies.
Correct synthetic natural-loss fixtures so their trigger ball advances into the curve end on the reset frame.
Add positive and negative tests for freeze_update binding and moving-versus-stationary terminal pretrigger behavior.
forbidden_changes: No c158 artifact edit or normalization.
No natural-loss trigger flag, f54, pending count, curve-end, recurrence, score, shooter, RNG, or empty-chain criterion change.
No simulator behavior change in this repair.
No PC Golden, mechanism audit plan, Fidelity Gate, or Training Gate threshold change.
No feature-specific exception keyed to c158 path, hash, update, ball id, score, or level.

decision_rule.repair_pass: All required tests pass and the unmodified c158 source independently derives exactly one natural_loss proof with every unchanged recurrence condition.
decision_rule.repair_fail: Retain test output, do not package the source, and do not weaken another condition under this preregistration.
